title: Sample sheet schema
description: Schema for the TSV file provided with params.input. See nextflow/README.md#sample-sheet.

family_id.errorMessage: family_id must be provided and contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must be provided and contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores

bam.errorMessage: bam must be provided, must exist, and must have extension '.bam' or '.cram'

bai.errorMessage: bai must be provided, must exist, and must have extension '.bai' or '.crai'
